title: Corporate Receptionist
description:
Corporate Receptionist - Basingstoke - Temporary (Immediate Start)

Location: Basingstoke

Hours of Work: Mon - Fri 9am - 6pm

Hourly Pay Rate: 18.78p/h Via Umbrella

A World Leading Service Provider who operates on an International scale is seeking an experienced Corporate Receptionist based in the Basingstoke area on a Temporary Contract working in large corporate office site. The successful candidate would ideally need to be very client facing and has good experience working in a FOH environment.

Key Responsibilities include:

Welcoming all staff and visitors and act as host to create excellent relationships with the customers (To make refreshments as and when required)

Management of the staff car parking and visitor spaces.

Arrange all business lunches, conference room bookings and conference calls dial in.

Ensure the front of house is kept tidy and regular checks of visitor washrooms.

Manage all incoming and outgoing post, parcels and couriers

Welcome delivery drivers and couriers.

Sign for parcels and place in post room for recipient to collect (keep records).

Keep the telephone listings up to date at all times and liaise daily with the Service Centre to ensure the telephone and Contract lists are up to date so they can receive incoming calls.

To answer internal calls only.

Administration duties for the Service Centre and the Finance Teams (or any other department upon the request of your manager).

To keep all Front of House Literature up to date and tidy

The successful candidate must be able to demonstrate the following:

Customer Service and Front of House experience is required.

Excellent communication (face to face, telephone and written)

Well presented with excellent attention to detail.

Extremely organised individual.

If this role would be of any interest or you know someone that might be of interest then please do apply below

title: Credit Controller
description:
The Opportunity

If you are hoping to join a truly fantastic company who foster an outstanding team culture then this could be just they job you have been looking for. The position of Credit Controller is offered on a 3 month contract basis and they also offer a hybrid working pattern. Based in Basingstoke, this is an exceptional opportunity for an experienced credit controller to work with a highly prestigious brand.

Responsibilities
- Collections focused role, maintaining a significant but very well maintained ledger
- Mix of key accounts and smaller companies, including B2 B and B2 C (consumer debt)
- Pro-actively resolving queries
- Performing credit checks where necessary and reviewing existing accounts
- Use of 2 bespoke accounting systems as well as MS Excel

About You
- Suitable applicants will be available on a maximum of a weeks notice
- Shorter term contract can be considered if that suits you
- Must be a very team orientated individual

title: Hire Operations Coordinator
description:
Hire Operations Coordinator

Location: Basingstoke
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm
Salary: Circa 32,000 DOE

Are you a highly organised and customer-focused professional looking for a varied role where you can make a real impact?

We are seeking a proactive Hire Operations Coordinator to join a growing and successful business in Basingstoke. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys balancing customer service, administration and operational responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.

The Role

As a Hire Operations Coordinator, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the hire function, delivering exceptional service to customers from initial enquiry through to equipment return.

Key responsibilities include:
- Managing customer enquiries via phone and email
- Producing quotations, order confirmations and invoices
- Building and maintaining strong customer relationships
- Coordinating hire orders and ensuring timely dispatch
- Picking, packing and preparing equipment for hire
- Managing stock levels and equipment availability
- Inspecting, cleaning and processing returned equipment
- Maintaining accurate records and system updates
- Supporting the wider team to ensure excellent customer service standards are achieved

About You

The successful candidate will have:
- Strong communication and customer service skills
- Excellent organisational and administrative abilities
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office
- The ability to prioritise workloads and manage multiple tasks
- A positive, flexible and hands-on approach

Previous experience within hire, rental, logistics, operations, administration, customer service or internal sales would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Full product and systems training
- A varied role with a mix of office-based and operational duties
- Supportive team environment
- Opportunities for development and progression within a growing business

If you're looking for a role that offers variety, responsibility and the opportunity to develop your career, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to find out more.

title: Sales Representative
salary_text: £25600 - £34500 per year (28 days holiday, pension, company si)
description:
SALES EXECUTIVE / SALES REPRESENTATIVE - FORKLIFTS, WAREHOUSE EQUIPMENT AND MACHINERY

Basingstoke, Hampshire £25,600 to £34,500 a year Permanent Full training provided No forklift experience needed

ABOUT THE ROLE

Do you enjoy talking to customers and helping them find the right product? We are looking for a friendly, organised Sales Executive / Sales Representative to sell new and used forklifts, material handling equipment and plant machinery to customers across the UK and overseas.

You will speak to customers by phone, email and face to face, prepare quotations and follow up sales leads. You do not need forklift experience. We provide full product and forklift training, and you will learn from an experienced team.

ABOUT PHL UK LTD

PHL is one of Europe's largest forklift truck wholesalers. We prepare and sell forklifts and material handling equipment to customers worldwide from a busy and growing site in Basingstoke, Hampshire with nearly 1,000 machines.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Speak with customers regularly by phone, email and face to face.
- Sell new and used forklifts and material handling equipment in the UK and overseas.
- Respond to customer enquiries and follow up sales leads.
- Prepare quotations and follow them up with customers.
- Build good relationships with existing customers and find new ones.
- Keep accurate customer and sales records on our CRM and other systems.
- Learn about our stock and the different types of equipment.
- Work closely with our marketing, transport and workshop teams.
- Work towards sales targets and build your own customer base.

WHO THIS ROLE SUITS

Experience from any of these areas would be a good fit: sales, internal or inside sales, account management, business development, telesales, customer service, trade counter, plant hire, machinery or engineering. Experience of selling to businesses (B2 B) is a bonus, but it is not essential.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The most important thing is finding the right person, so we will train you in everything about our products.

Essential:
- Good spoken and written English, because you will deal with customers by phone and email every day.
- Confidence speaking to customers on the phone.
- Comfortable using computers, including email, Word and Excel, and happy to learn new software such as a CRM system.
- Well organised, with good attention to detail when preparing quotations.
- Able to work independently and as part of a team.
- Keen to learn about our products and the industry.
- The right to work in the UK.

Useful, but not essential:
- Previous sales experience in any field.
- Experience in machinery, plant, engineering or industrial equipment.
- Experience using a CRM system, such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

WHAT WE OFFER
- Salary: £25,600 to £34,500 per year, depending on experience
- Location: Basingstoke, Hampshire
- Holiday: 20 days plus 8 bank holidays (28 days in total)
- Workplace pension scheme
- Company sick pay scheme
- Full product and forklift training provided
- The chance to progress and develop your own customer base

HOW TO APPLY

Apply online through this job listing. In your application, please tell us:
- Do you have the right to work in the UK?
- Do you have previous sales experience? If so, please tell us briefly about it.
- Do you have experience of dealing with customers by phone and email?
- What attracts you to a career in sales?

We will check your right to work in the UK before you start.

PHL UK Ltd welcomes applications from everyone. We make decisions based on skills, experience and suitability for the role. If you need any adjustments to apply or to attend an interview, please tell us.
